superJump.name: Super Jump
superJump.description: Jump an owned chip to any distant empty cell (3+ steps away).
superJump.instruction: Select an owned chip to jump, then choose a distant destination.

convert.name: Chief
convert.description: Convert an enemy chip directly to your color without capturing neighbors.
convert.instruction: Select an enemy chip to convert.

block.name: Block
block.description: Remove an enemy chip and turn its cell into a blocked obstacle.
block.instruction: Select an enemy chip to block.

wall.name: Wall
wall.description: Turn any empty cell into a blocked obstacle.
wall.instruction: Select an empty cell to place a wall.

doubleMove.name: Double Move
doubleMove.description: Take two moves this turn instead of one.

spawn.name: Spawn
spawn.description: Place a new chip on any empty cell without capturing neighbors.
spawn.instruction: Select an empty cell to spawn a chip.

superClone.name: Super Clone
superClone.description: Place a new chip on any empty cell and capture all adjacent enemy chips.
superClone.instruction: Select an empty cell for Super Clone.

unblock.name: Unblock
unblock.description: Remove a blocked obstacle, opening the cell for moves.
unblock.instruction: Select a blocked obstacle to unblock.

bomb.name: Bomb
bomb.description: Destroy an enemy chip and clear all marks from its cell.
bomb.instruction: Select an enemy chip to bomb.
